content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Understanding how to sell design assets using crypto payments is crucial for creators locked out of conventional payment methods. Platforms like Gumroad impose fees as high as 10%, which can drastically reduce profits. For example, if you sell a product at $97 and make 100 sales per month, you could lose $1,000 to platform fees. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing you to keep an additional $921 each month. This difference in infrastructure can be the key to financial sustainability for digital creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of selling design assets via crypto relies on a combination of accessible and reliable technologies. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can host your digital storefront for free, while backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For order storage, you can utilize Supabase or Google Sheets, both of which are free and user-friendly. This entire setup allows for automated delivery of your products, ensuring customers receive their downloads instantly after payment confirmation via NOWPayments. This infrastructure not only streamlines the sales process but also enables full data ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions, such as Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe. These individuals typically sell digital products like ebooks, templates, and courses but find themselves unable to use popular payment processors. By utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, these creators can establish a reliable sales channel that gives them complete control over their transactions and data. This empowers them to sell without the constraints imposed by traditional payment systems, ensuring they can monetize their work effectively.
NOWPayments lets you keep 99.5% of your sales revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several essential components that function harmoniously. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages backend processes. Supabase or Google Sheets acts as the database for storing orders, and file delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The payment processing is facilitated by NOWPayments, which allows users to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for identity verification. This seamless integration creates a robust infrastructure that minimizes reliance on external platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by deploying your hosting solution using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, connect your order storage system through Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure your file delivery mechanism is in place via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, configure NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions. Following these steps will enable you to launch your digital store and start selling design assets with confidence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes a hosting solution, backend logic, order storage, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. This infrastructure allows you to retain more of your revenue while automated delivery ensures customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Your data remains solely yours — no third-party access.

To set up your own store, start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, link your order storage to Supabase or Google Sheets, and set up NOWPayments for processing transactions.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my sales?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wide range of customers worldwide.

NOWPayments charges a transparent fee of only 0.5% on transactions, which is significantly lower than many conventional platforms like Gumroad. This ensures you retain more of your revenue from sales.

No, NOWPayments does not require KYC (Know Your Customer) checks, which allows for a smoother selling experience. You can focus on your business without the burden of extensive verification processes.
